fields.statement: QA at 728608f3 with the built binary (go build ./cmd/rhiza into the session scratchpad), hands-on in a scratch root outside ~/code with two registered projects (a, b), fake rex, RHIZA_* unset, hermetic HOME. Project a (first in turn order) had two accepted milestone change sets ready; project b had a failed flaky-workflow run queued with rhiza run resume --retry. rhiza daemon --max-runs 1 --once at the root printed only 'Resumed run <b's run>', no 'Started a run of' for a. Then in b: one live running run (journal naming a live sleep pid) and two interrupted runs queued with rhiza run resume. With --max-runs 2 the one free slot went to b's oldest continuation (Resumed run QUEUEDONE01), not a's change sets; with --max-runs 4 the picks were QUEUEDTWO02 plus a's One and Two. go test -trimpath ./internal/daemon/... ok; TestScripts daemon-continue-slot, daemon-round-robin, describe-golden PASS.

QA at 728608f3 with the built binary, hands-on in a scratch two-project root (fake rex, RHIZA_* unset): in project b, one running run, two interrupted runs queued with rhiza run resume (QUEUEDONE01 then QUEUEDTWO02) and one interrupted run with nothing queued (PLAININT003); rhiza daemon --max-runs 1 --once, then status. Root rhiza daemon status under 'Project b:' and project b's own rhiza daemon status both printed 'QUEUEDONE01 interrupted, queued, waiting for a slot (place 1)', 'QUEUEDTWO02 ... (place 2)', 'PLAININT003 interrupted' and 'RUNNING0001 running'. Root status --json gave projects[b].runs with queued 1 and 2 on the two queued runs and no queued field on PLAININT003 or the running run. describe-golden and daemon-continue-slot testscripts PASS.
